page.overview:
Who is Basina of Magritta?

Basina of Magritta was the mother of Karolina Lothar. She was of Estalian origin, and the second wife of Baron Oswain Lothar of Thessos in the Border Princes.

She died when her daughter was only six years old. A wild boar startled her horse while she was out hunting with her husband. Her mount reared and she fell from the saddle. She landed badly and broke her neck.

She had a stern face with the same dark hair and severe cheekbones as her daughter.
